recipes.note: hand-written: 13 byte-identical ListenerList::Add instantiations exist (0x011259A0..0x0117D7D0); they differ only in the std::function copy helper they call, so the rel32 of that call (offset 0x8A) is left fixed to pick the copy the engine uses for SubscribeFunction<CameraModeChanged>. Any sibling would behave identically; see spec 2026-09-03-ges-event-bus-design.md
